newsitem.title: POLAND: RAIFFEISEN POLISH UNIT UPS CAPITAL TO PLN 122 MLN.
newsitem.headline: RAIFFEISEN POLISH UNIT UPS CAPITAL TO PLN 122 MLN.

text.p: Raiffeisen Centrobank SA, the Polish subsidiary of Raiffeisen Zentralbank Oesterreich AG increased its share capital by 82.7 million zlotys to 122 million zlotys, the bank said on Thursday.
The bank said in a statement the bank's own assets would increase to 175.4 million zlotys.
It said the bank earlier decided to retain all of its 1996 10.9 million zloty profit.
Raiffeisen Centrobank is 75-percent owned by Raiffeisen Zentralbank and in 25-percent by Centro Internationale Handelsbank AG. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
